question: Can coverage relations plus an independent missing-claim veto produce a nontrivial, semantically reviewed selective patch, where direct deletion output was empty on real metadata and unsafe on elementary controls?
prior_turn_classification: progress: eight frozen control calls falsified universal abstention and exposed unsafe action/rationale mismatches; no original performance claim
facts: The real Middle and Late metadata had zero nonblank whole-line exact duplicates within descriptions or complete schema strings. Exact identity guarding alone cannot make a nonempty intervention on this input.
The previous control study had three unsafe deletions among eight outputs. Two public rationale fields recognized missing coverage while the executable array still deleted the information.

Prior semantic maintenance performed claim retain/replace decisions and structural repair; the project deletion version emitted edit operations directly. Neither separated proposed semantic coverage, independent missing-claim feedback and deterministic witness-protecting edit selection.
hypothesis: Separating relation discovery from verification and edit compilation may prevent some unsafe updates and enable conservative semantic deduplication. If this produces useful knowledge reduction without losing information, it may reduce actor context/interpretation burden. This last link remains unproven.

candidate_comparison.difference: Relations rather than imperative edits; separate raw-text gap feedback without producer opinion; program protects witnesses and derives edits; final semantic review rejects the entire version on any loss.

candidate_comparison.evidence: exact-inventory.json finds zero eligible whole-line exact coverage in either real stage; adding this guard to an empty producer cannot produce an intervention.

candidate_comparison.reason: It could address additional meaning, but expands editorial decisions without testing the newly observed action/coverage mismatch. Earlier math replacement failure does not ban this direction permanently.

method_sources.name: Self-Refine
method_sources.mechanism: Generate, obtain actionable feedback and revise until a fixed or feedback-based stop. The CommonGen implementation checks missing concepts, also correcting some feedback by token/lemma matching.
method_sources.needs: The same LLM, task-specific feedback/iteration prompts and source requirements; no extra training is intrinsic to this method. Author examples and sampling differ from this project.
method_sources.borrowed: A distinct semantic feedback step that identifies omitted information. Our host performs one conservative selection step, not the author's generative revision loop.
method_sources.not_borrowed: No actor retries, author task examples, training, decoder settings, unbounded refinement or benchmark feedback. This is not a full Self-Refine replication.

method_sources.name: Chain-of-Verification
method_sources.version: Published ACL Findings 2024, DOI 10.18653/v1/2024.findings-acl.212, sections 3.3 and 4.4
method_sources.mechanism: Separate verification context from the initial answer to reduce copying of its errors. The paper compares joint, two-step and factored checks; open questions perform better than simple binary confirmations in its reported setting.
method_sources.needs: Multiple same-model calls and appropriate questions; author experiments use different tasks/models and few-shot demonstrations.
method_sources.borrowed: A fresh checker context with exact source claim/evidence, without producer judgments. Ask for missing information rather than a deletion approval. Checks are batched per stage, not fully independent per claim.
method_sources.code_status: No author repository identified on the paper or checked author page; no repository SHA is invented. Used as a published design rationale only. Executable feedback structure is separately pinned in Self-Refine above.
method_sources.difference: Templated document coverage checks and deterministic editing, not open-domain factual verification or the complete four-step CoVe method. Same-model correlated error remains possible.

method_sources.name: EasyTool
method_sources.borrowed: Reuse previously audited redundancy-removal rationale only; no new literature search or claim that author staged execution is reproduced.

boundary_and_sources.constraint: Changed/added records only, standalone bullet/numbered lines, preserved witnesses, 500 characters per stage
boundary_and_sources.authority: This candidate's implementation and predeclared feasibility rules, not permanent research bans

review_integration: Adopt prior independent review's distinction between semantic truth and valid citations, and between version failure and family failure. No positive actor episode is required for this metadata-only candidate. Do not equate adding an LLM call with novelty: the changed decision is semantic gap veto plus host-selected edits.
competition_and_falsifiers: If relations remain empty or retained edits remove fewer than 500 characters per stage, this version does not establish a meaningful intervention; stop before actors.
If any selected deletion loses a unique clause despite checker approval, semantic admission fails and closes the whole version. More calls alone are not evidence of safer knowledge.

If a safe patch enters development but completion/core do not both improve, context redundancy may not be the dominant burden, or the removed repetition may have aided salience. The actor trial alone cannot isolate pure length from emphasis.
A same-model checker may share errors; independent request context is not statistical or evaluator independence. Human review remains required and its role is disclosed.
minimum_trial: Two stage proposals and at most two stage checkers, fixed settings and independent ledger; structural repair only. All outputs preserved, no semantic regeneration. Conditional original 10-cell development and two 30-cell validation blocks retain the preceding frozen tasks, rubric and strict gates.
cost: Generation estimate USD 0.005–0.06, not a cap; updater costs reported separately from any later actor/judge calls.
